GEQ_BAND_RANGE.doc: One graphic-EQ fader's travel: EQ_GAIN_RANGE by reference (a graphic fader is an EQ gain), with the come-up value it needs as a row field — flat, 0 dB (graphic-eq-31 spec §3).

GEQ_BAND_Q.doc: The graphic EQ's band Q: the ISO third-octave bandwidth, `2^(1/6)/(2^(1/3) − 1) ≈ 4.318`, to one decimal as the M32 GEQ carries it. Read by the `geq31` preset and the graphic EQ's section design (graphic-eq-31 spec §3).

GEQ_PROTO_DB.doc: The prototype gain the `true` solve's first interaction matrix is evaluated at (spec §2, §3): the middle of the travel's magnitude, where a matched-Z section's dB response per dB of gain is closest to its average.

GEQ_DESIGN_GAIN_MAX_DB.doc: The ceiling on a section gain the `true` solve may ask for (spec §3): above the travel's worst case (26.0 dB, the alternating ±15 set) with margin. A solve past it clamps and the row says so (`designClamped`), never silently.
